future_acceptance_obligations: Bit-pattern/NaN/signed-zero/subnormal/range fixtures and exact count/conversion properties per format.
Analytical accumulation and narrowing budgets with actual device/precision receipts.
contracts.recommended_typed_generic_boundary: Keep Eunomia representation/rounding/overflow/NaN/signed-zero and associated accumulator law as SSOT; make software-evaluation boundaries explicit in capability/mode evidence rather than inferring native execution from storage dtype.
contracts.scope: Scalar format/bit layout, native precision and explicit accumulator/conversion laws
contracts.source_observation: NumericElement supplies sealed Self->Self arithmetic, constants, checked count conversion and BYTE_WIDTH; FloatElement declares an associated Accumulator; Zeroable/Pod are separate unsafe representation contracts.
unclosed_contract_axes: Closed numeric traits are not a complete string/object/structured/resource element model.
Per-format hardware intrinsics/software boundaries and every conversion error domain remain separately qualified.

future_acceptance_obligations: Exhaustive finite dtype-pair policy table conservation, exact representable boundaries, errors before output mutation, x64/default-dtype modes.
Analytical/differential tests for signed/unsigned/complex/reduced formats and gradients through allowed casts.
contracts.recommended_typed_generic_boundary: Propose one Eunomia generic promotion/cast policy seam parameterized by operand types and explicit source-policy/context ZSTs, with associated output and typed rejection. Leto and Coeus consume it instead of duplicating promotion in kernels. Exact source tables are separate semantic inputs, not inferred here.
contracts.scope: Mixed-operand result type and value conversion/casting policy
contracts.source_observation: Inspected NumericElement arithmetic has Output=Self; scalar integer conversion exists, but these declarations do not define the four-framework weak-scalar/default-dtype/mixed-rank promotion tables.

unclosed_contract_axes: Each reference version promotion lattice, weak scalar/array distinction, explicit dtype overrides, device admission and cast modes need exact contracts.
No mixed-operand join is established by the inspected homogeneous scalar signatures.

future_acceptance_obligations: Exact address-set oracles, negative/zero strides, arbitrary injectivity, offset/noncontiguous layouts, scalar/empty and overflow cases.
View/copy observability, byte-preserving transpose/reshape, error timing and dtype/device preservation.
contracts.recommended_typed_generic_boundary: Retain Leto as shape/layout algebra owner. Resolve the Coeus unsigned facade versus signed canonical descriptor through a reviewed metadata boundary; preserve observable view/copy/alias outcomes, offset, order and rejection timing. Finite rank dispatch is an explicit bound.
contracts.scope: Shape product, strides, offset, scalar/empty, broadcast/view and physical footprint
contracts.source_observation: Leto Layout<N> uses signed element strides and validates shape/offset arithmetic; LayoutDyn is a runtime-rank boundary carrier sharing kernels, not a universal runtime-rank compute claim. Coeus has separate unsigned-stride metadata and converts through coeus_cpu.
unclosed_contract_axes: Coeus Strides=SmallVec<usize> cannot encode a negative stride.
Layout::from_shape_strides and numel are not the same validated construction contract as Leto try_new.
Dynamic rank carriers and gamma rank0..6 execution do not close arbitrary-rank computation.

future_acceptance_obligations: Byte-address analytical overlap oracles and duplicate-index/update-order witnesses.
Zero-size/zero-stride/negative-stride, scalar mask/OOB modes, repeated updates and failure-before-partial-mutation cases.
contracts.recommended_typed_generic_boundary: Keep geometry, indexing and traversal in Leto, physical permission in Melinoe, and source-specific tensor mutation/version/AD rules in Coeus. A policy must say whether aliasing writes reject, update deterministically, accumulate or use a snapshot.
contracts.scope: Array indexing, overlap, duplicate writes, mutable traversal and assignment ordering
contracts.source_observation: Leto validates footprint and exposes exact is_injective; assign_into routes non-injective destinations through serial logical traversal. ArrayViewMut wraps an exclusive slice and checked construction validates storage extent; this alone does not specify every comparator overlap policy.

supplier_roles.role: nonforgeable exclusive/shared access and disjoint shards

Failure cleanup, retained/borrowed zero-copy lifetime and native/Miri evidence in its owned execution lane.
contracts.recommended_typed_generic_boundary: Keep allocation/ownership/failure cleanup in Mnemosyne; distinguish raw capacity/uninitialized slots from initialized tensor values and typed nonescaping lifetime. Array alias policy does not belong in the allocator.
contracts.scope: Allocation bounds/alignment, initialized length, drop/move, retention and lifetime
contracts.source_observation: Mnemosyne owns GlobalAlloc and low-level MemoryBackend mapping. BrandedVec tracks ptr/cap/len/heap, has !Send/!Sync marker, and requires brand permits for allocation/growth; consumers Leto/Coeus adapt storage separately.
unclosed_contract_axes: No allocator API alone proves a tensor view is in bounds or injective.
Failure atomicity, ZST, panic/drop and each placement/backend lifetime still need operation evidence.

future_acceptance_obligations: Compile-fail alias/brand/lifetime cases, disjoint address partitions and token-return state checks.
Actual backend stream/fence/readback execution; require acquired hardware, no early-return credit.
contracts.recommended_typed_generic_boundary: Use Melinoe tokens/typestates for access phase transitions, retaining explicit backend completion evidence. Keep Melinoe foundational: capability prerequisite gates must not be interpreted as adding a Melinoe->Mnemosyne/Themis library edge and creating a crate cycle.
contracts.scope: Read/write exclusivity, disjoint regions, token handoff and observer windows
contracts.source_observation: Melinoe seals ReadPermit/WritePermit around one BrandOwner and provides disjoint WriterShard. Device tests use real Hephaestus stream copy+synchronize, but return early when no adapter. They are source examples, not hardware receipts here.
unclosed_contract_axes: Submission versus completion and readback visibility are separate target-specific obligations.
Adapter absence/early return counts as unexecuted hardware coverage.
Current Coeus GradBuffer serialization invariant is not an existing Melinoe typed-permit integration.

future_acceptance_obligations: Typed placement conflict rejection, epoch/topology validity and exact requested-versus-observed target evidence.
contracts.recommended_typed_generic_boundary: Keep topology facts and placement legality in Themis; allocation, kernel execution and scheduling remain provider responsibilities. A requested tier/device or tag is not an observed execution receipt.
contracts.source_observation: Themis states placement vocabulary ownership, not allocation or execution. Branded PinnedStorage requires unique borrow for a placement tag and preserves one tag with stored cells.
unclosed_contract_axes: Actual honoring/rejection of hints and physical locality/device observations remain target-specific.

contracts.scope: Typed resident buffers, initialization/transfer, device limits and native dispatch
contracts.source_observation: Hephaestus ComputeDevice::Buffer<T:Pod> is the typed device allocation seam; StridedView simply pairs borrowed buffer/layout and leaves operation validation to consumer. DeviceApi supplies compilation, pointer, same-allocation alias and launch seams.

contracts.scope: Tensor object identity, dtype/device/layout facade, value retention and copy/view behavior
contracts.source_observation: Tensor<T,B> contains B::DeviceBuffer<T> and Coeus Layout; clone/views share cloned storage, while StorageMut promises COW detachment. This is a concrete value-retention contract, not universal NumPy/PyTorch shared-write alias equivalence.
unclosed_contract_axes: PyTensor contains Var<f64>; float()/double() clone; long()/int() round through i64 then store f64. These are dtype parity gaps.
Unsigned facade strides and finite rank adapters remain layout gaps.
General ComputeBackend host_staging_crossover explicitly allows host-consumed reduction CPU staging and cannot earn execution-device parity.

Keep foundational Melinoe independent; Mnemosyne/Themis consume it. Device/CPU/numeric suppliers precede Coeus consumers. Do not add a Coeus fallback owner to scalar/layout/allocation/placement/device work.

Native Quinn/Moirai migration and notification ownership, Apollo service hold/#696,Atlas#551 and Kwavers Miri lane remain untouched.
